title: Pokésouls concept. Imagine having a playstyle unique to each pokémon, all catchable and playable. (Sol 5.6, three.js)
author: differentguyscro

comments.author: Maxwell10206
comments.body: Concept is good, but we need to wait until AI gets better at visuals before it is worth pursuing imo.

replies.author: YesImYou
replies.body: But the worflow has changes. Now you just act as "senior dev" delegating the code to AI and you can focus almost all your efforts into Art and 3D. Which in my opinion s the perfect pipeline for a balance between production, taste, and vision.

replies.author: Maxwell10206
replies.body: that works too if you have Art and 3D Skills, which some of us don't including myself. ( Programmer originally ).

replies.author: YesImYou
replies.body: That's true. But it seems GameDev is moving to that place where the only thing that will matter is good taste and creative vision (whatever one considers those to be)

replies.author: Maxwell10206
replies.body: Yeah basically, once AI can complete the picture with being able to do really good 3D and 2D art and animations, etc. then things will get really interesting. It has the programming down.

replies.author: enkidook
replies.body: img2threejs already solves this in a big way. I'm sure there will be a lot more tools soon too.

replies.author: Maxwell10206
replies.body: I don't see something like a character model walking on their homepage which is probably the most important and hardest thing to do with AI that isn't just a big voxel slop mess.

replies.author: enkidook
replies.body:
Well the tool is a whopping 2 weeks old, and already pretty damn decent even if not perfect.

[There's other tools that seem pretty capable as well.](https://v.redd.it/tl9le3y5k8hh1)

replies.author: Maxwell10206
replies.body: according to the comments he used Mixamo for the animations. The models are not capable of this kind of work yet. We just gotta be patient my man.

comments.author: net_ninja
comments.body:
Seems promising.
A game with a similar concept exists. The name escapes me, but make sure you’re not recreating something that already does your idea better first
